patch_description: The second RTS refinement pass (Q/4) delivered the largest recent improvement (+0.05 combined). Extending to a third pass with geometrically decaying process noise (q3 = 0.0625·qa) exploits the twice-denoised output's statistics for further sharpening. To avoid over-smoothing already-converged segments, the pass is gated by an internal convergence check: stop if max|y_new − y_old| < 0.05·σ_r. This is the lowest-risk incremental extension of the proven winner, keeping the output contract identical.
